bounds_certificate: Every replay checks owned buffer extents/alignment, each image value before histogram indexing, sum(signed counts)==pop and each output store span. Integral entropy requires a static zero/copy invariant and representable finite result. Original calls happen only after that separate replay succeeds.
exclusions: No undersized source/mask/output backing allocation, fabricated as_strided, zero-depth destination or unaligned wide pointer is invoked. Every owned view span/alignment is checked before original calls.
Active u16 image/float output effective-type hazards are held pending even when every index would fit65536 bins.
Partial-bin u16 image mixed-byte feedback can manufacture indices above allocated histogram; require fullbins or a provenzero invariant.
Integral entropy feedback can require negative/out-of-range/nonfinite float-to-unsigned conversion; exclude except zero/copy invariants. No empirically observed wrap is promoted to defined parity.

Arbitrary object protocols/warning-hook mutations/global NumPy replacement are not part of this plain owned-array overlap increment. Existing1115/926 matrices and all benchmark corpora remain unchanged.
finite_domain: Per-case owned raster/update bounds imply finite integer counts and population in this finite corpus; when pop!=0 its absolute value is at leastone. Entropy classes record negative/zero/positive/nan/inf without normalization; no claim that arbitrary mask feedback has a nonnegative or physical distribution.

interface_proposal.capability: Keep histogram operation capability511 unchanged. Advertise alias support separately by operation and proven safety class, so a five/nine-op core cannot silently claim alias coverage.
interface_proposal.entropy: Ascending bins, p=double(count)/pop; only p>0 contributes e-=p*C_log(p)/0.6931471805599453. Negative population/entropy are observed; no clamping/log2/reassociation. Floating nonfinite results, if any, remain raw observable bits. Integral negative/nonfinite conversion remains outside defined coverage.
interface_proposal.layout: Preserve existing RankView layout and two-argument rank_filter_into ABI. Add a separate overload/entrypoint with prepared image/out and mask/out overlap bits (or equivalent validated alias descriptor). Do not overload bool serial_alias with bit patterns.
interface_proposal.median_interface: Return an explicit store flag/optional result from selection; pop==0 storeszero, successful CDF storesbin, no crossing doesnotstore. Do not read/convert existing float/bool destination just to preserve it.
interface_proposal.median_no_store: Preserve every existing destination byte when pop!=0 and the ascending nonzero-bin CDF never becomes negative.
interface_proposal.next_implementation: Replace proven compatibility forwarding with native serial execution and exact contracts, not additional upstream forwarding. Root owns public registry/shared wiring; this commit contains no native implementation.
interface_proposal.normalization: Classify actual prepared C image/u8 mask buffers after dtype/contiguity copies, not just raw caller owner identity. Copies/disjoint common-owner views have no feedback and retain parallel eligibility. Retain every owner/reference through execution.
safe_classes: u8 active image feedback with supported GMM outputs; char reads preserve the256-bin index domain
u16 GMM same-u16 destination, including offsets/larger C views; emitted indices/differences stay within initial bins, no-store preserves old words
u16 active image feedback into byte/bool GMM destination only with full65536 bins or provable zero-write invariant
mask/out feedback with independent image: GMM supported outputs; entropy float outputs; mask is byte truth membership regardless stored byte magnitude
entropy active u8 image feedback with float32/float64 destination; mask byte feedback float32/float64 may make population negative
entropy integral destination only when normalization copies remove all feedback, footprint is allzero, or allzero mask plus zerowrites stays invariant
interface_proposal.signed_histogram: Counts can be negative and source tests occupancy with count!=0. Preserve signed counts and any nonzero signed population; do not clip populations or histogram counts to valid probability distributions.
interface_proposal.traversal: For each plane: reset histogram/pop, build neighborhood at row0/col0 from current backing state; snake rows east/west; enter updates before leave updates; store after both borders complete. Entire actual feedback walk stays serial even when global workers=4.
interface_proposal.validation: Preserve source buffer/dtype/shift error order before any write. NumPy1.24 array1 shift reaches kernel; NumPy2.5 raises TypeError before kernel. 2D two-channel output runs/stores channel0 then squeeze raises after mutation;3D extra-channel shape is rejected before kernel. Unsafe extents remain safely rejected outside parity.

provenance.image_algorithms: Original rank functions plus independent test-only rolling replay. No candidate execution, forwarding acceptance, native implementation or timing evidence.
